description: This file defines the 'HeadlinesFragment' class, a subclass of ListFragment used in an Android app to display a list of headlines, handle item selection, and communicate selection events to the parent activity via a callback interface.

classes.name: HeadlinesFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays a list of headlines and communicates selections to the host activity.

classes.name: HeadlinesFragment.OnHeadlineSelectedListener
classes.description: Interface that host activities must implement to handle headline selection events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets the list adapter with headlines, choosing layout based on Android version.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Configuration of list view for two-pane layout by setting choice mode.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Ensures the activity implements the callback interface and stores a reference.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user selection of list items, notifies the activity, and highlights the selection.
